Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subtitle: Everything worth knowing about Guild Bazaar before launch.

about.question: What is Guild Bazaar?
about.answer: Guild Bazaar is a Polish platform for historical re-enactors, LARPers and cosplayers. It brings knightly guilds, re-enactment groups, artisans, vendors and event organisers together in one place. It also brings their handmade work to a wider audience, not just people from the scene.

audience.question: Who is the platform for?
audience.answer: The whole historical and fantasy scene: guild and association members, artisans (armourers, blacksmiths, tailors, leatherworkers), fair vendors and festival organisers. And anyone looking for unique handmade items, a costume or a gift with a story behind it.

groups.question: How do I find a re-enactment group?
groups.answer: Browse guild and association profiles from all over Poland and filter them by era, location and specialisation. You can contact a group directly through the platform.

sell.question: Can I sell my handmade work?
sell.answer: Yes. Artisans and vendors create a workshop profile and list armour, costumes, props, jewellery or made-to-order services. Your work will be seen not only by re-enactors but also by buyers outside the community. Buyers contact you directly and you agree the details between yourselves.

price.question: Is Guild Bazaar free?
price.answer: Yes, the platform is free to use and funded by ads. Extra promotion options for vendor profiles and listings may be added in the future.

launch.question: When does Guild Bazaar launch?
launch.answer: The platform is in development. Everyone on the waitlist will get an email before the official launch, with an invitation to the beta.

waitlist.question: How do I join the waitlist?
waitlist.answer: Fill in the form on this page and click the link in the confirmation email (valid for 7 days). You can unsubscribe at any time.

epochs.question: Is it only about the Middle Ages?
epochs.answer: No. Guild Bazaar covers every era and style: from antiquity and the Middle Ages, through the Renaissance and militaria, to fantasy, LARP and cosplay.

buyers.question: Do I have to be a re-enactor to buy something?
buyers.answer: No. Guild Bazaar is open to everyone. You'll find handmade costumes, jewellery, decorative weapons, props and décor, perfect as a gift, for a collection or for a costume party.
